title: Twitter (X) data input
description: Pick what to collect in Mode, then fill in the matching field below (search queries, usernames, tweet IDs, list IDs, community IDs or locations). Each query, user, tweet, list, community or location is collected up to Max items per input.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description:
What to collect. Each mode reads one of the fields below:
Search tweets: Search queries.
User tweets, User profiles, Followers, Following: Usernames or User IDs.
Tweet replies, Tweet retweeters: Tweet IDs or URLs.
List tweets: List IDs. Community tweets: Community IDs. Trends: Locations (WOEIDs).

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: For mode Search tweets. One query per line. X search operators work, for example from:nasa, "exact phrase", lang:en, since:2025-01-01, min_faves:100, -filter:replies. Max 512 characters per query.

searchCategory.title: Search tab
searchCategory.description: Which X search tab to read. Latest is newest first. People returns accounts instead of tweets.

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: For modes User tweets, User profiles, Followers and Following. One per line: nasa, @nasa or https://x.com/nasa.
usernames.sectionDescription: Used by modes User tweets, User profiles, Followers and Following. Fill in usernames, user IDs, or both.

userIds.title: User IDs
userIds.description: Numeric X user IDs (rest_id), one per line. Slightly faster than usernames. User profiles are fetched 100 IDs per request.

tweetIds.title: Tweet IDs or URLs
tweetIds.description: For modes Tweet replies and Tweet retweeters. One per line: the numeric ID or the tweet URL, e.g. https://x.com/nasa/status/1844000000000000001.

listIds.title: List IDs or URLs
listIds.description: For mode List tweets. Numeric list ID or URL, e.g. https://x.com/i/lists/1234567890.

communityIds.title: Community IDs or URLs
communityIds.description: For mode Community tweets. Numeric community ID or URL, e.g. https://x.com/i/communities/1234567890.

woeids.title: Trend locations (WOEID)
woeids.description: For mode Trends. Yahoo WOEIDs: 1 = worldwide, 23424977 = United States, 23424975 = United Kingdom, 23424829 = Germany. Defaults to worldwide.

maxItems.title: Max items per input
maxItems.description: Stop after this many results for each query, user, tweet, list, community or location. You pay per result, so this also caps the cost per input.

maxPages.title: Max pages per input
maxPages.description: Safety limit on requests per input. A page usually holds about 20 results. Raise it together with Max items for large pulls.

includeRaw.title: Include raw X data
includeRaw.description: Adds a raw field with X's original JSON for each item. Useful for fields this Actor does not flatten. Makes items much larger.
